title: Canvas exposes no md5 for any of this course's 140 files
detail: analyze_course's adoption tier (b) - the content match - can therefore never fire here, leaving only tier (c) (unique size+extension) for a file whose manifest row is gone. Note this does NOT weaken ordinary renames: heal_manifest Tier 2 matches on original_md5, which the app computes locally from the bytes it wrote, and works with no Canvas hash at all. Recorded because the tier-(b) comment reads as though it were the primary mechanism.
